address: 57-58 Broad Street, Lyme Regis, DY7 3QF, United Kingdom
bio: There’s a lovely, relaxed feel to this wine bar and restaurant; it’s a place where you can pop in for snacks and a glass of wine or two, or enjoy a full tasting menu experience. The cellar location has a rustic, cosy yet surprisingly spacious feel and the seasonal dishes make local ingredients a feature. In line with this ethos, the wine list spotlights natural, bio-dynamic and low-intervention options. Local botanicals and house-made ferments make their way into the creative cocktail selection....
